title: Superposed quantum evolutions across chaotic and regular regimes
summary: While the superposition of quantum evolutions is known to produce interference effects, the interference between evolutions with regular and chaotic classical limits remains largely unexplored. Here, we use a Mach-Zehnder interferometer to investigate the superposition of two quantum evolutions, implemented via post-selection, and to compare it with the corresponding classical mixture. The quantum kicked top provides a natural platform for this study, as its classical dynamics ranges from regular to mixed to fully chaotic depending on the Hamiltonian parameters.
